howItWorksPage.title: How mesteri.md works
howItWorksPage.subtitle: Our simple process helps you find the perfect handyman in just a few steps
howItWorksPage.ho_step1Desc: Fill out a simple form describing what work you need, the location and approximate budget. It takes less than 2 minutes.
howItWorksPage.ho_step2Desc: Handymen in your area will receive your request and send you personalized quotes with price, estimated duration and details.
howItWorksPage.ho_step3Desc: Compare quotes, read reviews, and choose the handyman that fits you best. Simple and transparent.
howItWorksPage.pr_step1Desc: Register for free and complete your profile with the services you offer, prices, portfolio and your experience.
howItWorksPage.pr_step2Desc: You'll receive requests from clients in your area looking for exactly the services you offer.
howItWorksPage.pr_step3Desc: Send quotes, complete jobs, collect positive reviews and grow your business on mesteri.md.
howItWorksPage.faq1q: Is it free to use mesteri.md?
howItWorksPage.faq1a: Yes, the platform is completely free for homeowners. You can post requests and receive quotes at no cost.
howItWorksPage.faq2a: We verify the identity, documents and experience of each handyman. We also monitor reviews and client feedback.
howItWorksPage.faq3q: How long does it take to receive quotes?
howItWorksPage.faq3a: You usually receive the first quotes in less than 24 hours. For urgent requests, responses can come in a few hours.
howItWorksPage.faq4q: What if I'm not satisfied with the work?
howItWorksPage.faq4a: We encourage you to communicate directly with the handyman. If you can't resolve the issue, our support team can help.
howItWorksPage.faq5a: Yes, you can cancel a request at any time before accepting a quote. After acceptance, contact the handyman directly.
howItWorksPage.faq6q: How much does it cost for handymen?
howItWorksPage.faq6a: Registration on the platform is free. Handymen pay a small commission only for jobs completed through the platform.
howItWorksPage.faq7q: How can I leave a review?
howItWorksPage.faq7a: After the job is completed, you'll receive an invitation to leave a review. You can rate the handyman with stars and write a detailed comment.
howItWorksPage.faq8q: Is it available in all of Moldova?
howItWorksPage.faq8a: Yes, mesteri.md covers all cities and localities in the Republic of Moldova. We have handymen in Chișinău, Bălți, Cahul and many other locations.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.s1text: By accessing and using the mesteri.md platform, you accept these terms and conditions in full. If you do not agree with any of these terms, please do not use the platform.
terms.s2text: mesteri.md is an online platform that connects homeowners with home service providers (handymen). The platform facilitates communication and is not part of the contract between the client and the handyman.
terms.s3text: To use certain features of the platform, you must create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
terms.s4text: Users agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information, to comply with applicable laws and not to use the platform for fraudulent or illegal purposes.
terms.s5text: mesteri.md does not guarantee the quality of services provided by handymen and is not responsible for any disputes between clients and service providers. The platform provides a review system to help users make informed decisions.
terms.s6text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be published on this page with the date of the last update.
terms.s7text: For questions regarding these terms, you can contact us at contact{'@'}mesteri.md.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1text: We collect information that you provide directly: name, email address, phone number, city and information about the services requested or offered.
privacy.s2text: We use the information collected to facilitate the connection between clients and handymen, improve the platform, communicate with you and ensure account security.
privacy.s3text: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties, except where necessary for the operation of the platform or when legally required.
privacy.s4text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, loss or destruction.
privacy.s5text: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data. You can also request restriction of processing or data portability.
privacy.s6text: We use cookies to improve the experience on the platform. You can control cookie preferences in your browser settings.
privacy.s7text: For privacy-related questions, contact us at privacy{'@'}mesteri.md.
